homeTitle: Ego Hygiene | Balance, awareness, empathy, and growth

about.description: The ideas behind Ego Hygiene: balance, awareness, empathy, and growth.
about.intro: Ego Hygiene is a framework for building steadier relationships with identity, emotion, creativity, and technology.
about.balance: Balance sits at the center: not as perfection, but as a practice of noticing, adjusting, and reconnecting.
about.identity: The galaxy yin-yang identity represents movement, contrast, and an ongoing effort to bring awareness and empathy into the tools we make.
about.progress: The platform is evolving in public, starting with a small, honest foundation.

ecosystem.description: Explore the tools and projects taking shape in the Ego Hygiene ecosystem.
ecosystem.intro: A typed product registry keeps the current platform honest while preparing the root site to become a gateway later.

privacy.description: A provisional explanation of the current website’s privacy practices.
privacy.intro: This provisional draft is here to explain the current state plainly.
privacy.current: This website does not require sign-in and has no form for submitting order or payment details.
privacy.external: Checkout and support links can take you to a separate service. Review that service’s privacy information before sharing personal or order details. Website feedback on GitHub is public.
privacy.future: Future changes will update this page before stronger guarantees are claimed.
privacy.preferences: The site can save theme and language preferences in your browser. If saving is blocked, those preferences may not be remembered on a later visit.

terms.description: Provisional terms for the Ego Hygiene public website.
terms.intro: These terms are provisional and describe a minimal public website release.
terms.use: Product previews and unfinished features are labeled and may change. A design preview is not a product purchase or permission to reuse the artwork.
terms.store: Available physical products link to a separate checkout. Before paying, review the actual product, options, total, delivery eligibility, returns policy, and support information there. These website terms do not replace the terms shown for that purchase.
terms.limits: No warranties or service-level guarantees are implied by this draft.

storeHelp.title: Store help
storeHelp.description: Understand product previews, hosted checkout, delivery information, and where to get help with the Ego Hygiene store.
storeHelp.intro: A guide to browsing the store and checking the details before you buy.
storeHelp.products: The store is for physical products bearing designs. Design pages show the artwork behind those products; they do not offer artwork files for download or a license to reuse them.
storeHelp.previews: Products marked Preview or Unavailable cannot be purchased. Fictional examples are labeled in their descriptions and are not real offers.
storeHelp.images: Artwork previews and concept images do not show a finished product. A product mockup is not evidence of a received or physically inspected sample. Check the provider’s actual product details before buying.
storeHelp.checkout: An available product’s purchase link takes you to the checkout provider. This website does not take your payment or submit an order for you.
storeHelp.options: Choose and confirm the product options at the provider. Check the current price and final total, including shipping, tax, and any other charges, before paying. A price displayed here is not the final checkout total.
storeHelp.delivery: Use the shipping and returns links on the available product’s page, then confirm delivery eligibility, timing, and return conditions for your order at the provider. Browsing in a language does not establish delivery to a country.
storeHelp.orders: Use the order-support link on the available product’s page. Check your order confirmation for any order-specific support instructions. This website has no order-support form.
storeHelp.orderPrivacy: Send order numbers, delivery addresses, and other private details only through the appropriate private support channel. Public website feedback is not an order-support channel.
storeHelp.website: If a page or control is difficult to use, you can report it through the website’s GitHub issues. Include the page URL, what you were trying to do, and what happened. Browser or assistive-technology details can help if you choose to share them.
storeHelp.feedbackLink: Report a website problem on GitHub
storeHelp.policies: These pages explain the current website and remain provisional. Their presence is not a claim of legal, privacy, security, or accessibility compliance.

help.title: Help
help.description: Find website help, accessibility feedback, store guidance and policy information for Ego Hygiene.
help.intro: Find your way around the website, report a problem, or learn how the store works.
help.explore: Read About Ego Hygiene for the ideas behind the project. Visit the store to explore designs and clearly labelled product previews. Store help explains product availability, checkout and where to find order support.
help.feedback: To report a website problem, share the page address, what you were trying to do and what happened. Remove any private information from links or screenshots. Browser or assistive-technology details are optional; share them only if you are comfortable doing so.
help.orders: Public website feedback is not an order-support channel. For an available product, use its order-support link and any instructions in your order confirmation. Send private order details only through the appropriate private support channel. This website has no order-support form.
help.policies: The privacy and terms pages describe the current website and remain provisional. They are not a claim that legal, privacy, security or accessibility review is complete. Product-specific policies belong with the actual offer.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.description: Current accessibility information, review limitations and ways to report a problem using the Ego Hygiene website.
accessibility.intro: We are working to make this website easier to use. Accessibility review is ongoing. We have not completed an assessment of every page, browser or assistive technology.
accessibility.using: The website includes a Skip to content link and theme controls. These can help with navigation and appearance, but they do not establish that every page or control is accessible.
accessibility.review: Keyboard and focus behavior, contrast, reduced motion, zoom and smaller-screen layouts still need a complete review. Testing with assistive technologies is also incomplete. We will update this information as those checks are completed.
accessibility.feedback: If a page or control is difficult to use, tell us which page you visited, what you were trying to do and what happened. You can include browser or assistive-technology details if you choose. Do not include private information.
accessibility.feedbackLink: Report an accessibility problem on GitHub
